shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab/stele with a rounded or pointed top
animal forms in profile (quadruped/bird-like creatures in A; animal-headed elements and bird signs in B)
repeated small motifs arranged in a row
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing shallow relief organised loosely into stacked zones with rows of small repeated motifs, and both include animal forms in profile, but that is about the extent of the correspondence. A shows abstract, schematic zoomorphic and geometric figures (arch-like curves, a row of birds/quadrupeds, a snake-like band) with no human presence, while B shows a clearly narrative human scene: seated and standing anthropomorphic figures facing one another with offerings, headdresses, staffs and columns of script-like signs — an entirely different iconographic scheme and level of naturalism.
